## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the related task or issue when applicable.

## Validation

List the checks actually performed and their results. For game checks, record game/client versions and display mode.

## Regression protection

For behavior changes, identify the protected scenario/requirement and tests added or updated. For bug fixes, describe the retained reproduction case or explain why an automated regression case is not feasible. Note any migration, packaging, or real-game checks required by the change. For documentation-only changes, write "Not applicable: documentation only" and report document checks above.

## Remaining verification

Describe any unverified behavior or unavailable tools/games, or write "None".
